fr_html: Le PRESIDENT met aux voix l'alinéa 2 de l'amendement de M. Hagerup. Cet amendement est adopté. MM. de Lapradelle, Ricci-Busatti et Altamira se sont abstenus.
en_html: The PRESIDENT put the second Paragraph of M. Hagerup's amendment to the vote. This amendment was adopted. MM. de Lapradelle, Ricci-Busatti and Altamira abstained from voting.
